labels.desc: Lateral cord: the most lateral of the three in the cluster (here the medial cord is the shallowest).

Medial to the cords: check with colour Doppler and keep the needle lateral to it.

Subclavius, deep to pectoralis major, roofs the space.
Deep and medial: keep the needle tip away from it.
